description:

title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
description:
## Company Name
ARS-Rescue Rooter
## Overview
The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution.
The role is DevOps-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure-as-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards.
The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants.
## Responsibilities
## Key Responsibilities
## Azure Infrastructure Engineering & Operations
• Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance.
• Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
• Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on-call.
## Hybrid Networking, DNS & Application Delivery
• Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior.
• Design name resolution across Azure and on-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding).
• Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints.
• Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure-mode design when an edge service or policy fails.
• Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third-party connectivity.
## Migration Execution
• Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift-and-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post-migration support.
• Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off-hours production cutovers.
• Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs).
• Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads.
## Resiliency, Backup & Disaster Recovery
• Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo-redundant storage, and region/availability-zone design against RTO and RPO targets.
• Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results.
## Platform Services Infrastructure
• Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring.
• Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development.
## Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code
• Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift.
• Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self-hosted agents reaching private endpoints.
• Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI.
## Identity, Security & Governance
• Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties.
• Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud.
• Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence.
## Observability & Cost Management
• Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing.
• Right-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines.
## Collaboration & Cross-Training
• Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise.
## Qualifications
## Required Qualifications
Note: Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.
• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
• 5+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on production Azure.
• Hybrid networking: hands-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site-to-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior.
• On-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration support.
• Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
• Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets.
• Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines.
• Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy.
• Independent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex Azure issues.
• Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements.
## Technical Skills
Working knowledge
• Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs.
• Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel.
• AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, AZ-500, AZ-400) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current.
• AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations.
• PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi-site hybrid environments.
• Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting.
## Work Details
• Remote; work day would be in Central Time Zone.
• Regular business hours with scheduled after-hours maintenance and cutovers, occasional incident response, and on-call as required; participation in change management (CAB).
• Occasional travel for project work, meetings, or datacenter activities.

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com
**Candidate Note: This position is 100% remote for candidates based in US**
We're looking for a Staff Engineer that will focus on a Database Platform that supports Postgres estates and fleets. This position owns the packaging and delivery of a number of Kubernetes operators, across the supported cloud Kubernetes environments (EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift/RHOS, kind). The work spans Kubernetes packaging, container builds and CI/CD, Postgres-on-Kubernetes infrastructure, and the customer documentation for those capabilities, and it contributes to database release readiness for each release cycle. You will be part of a supportive team with a breadth of experience.
## What you will be doing:
• Solving problems for customers by developing easy-to-use systems and features for EDB’s database platform offering(s).
• Leveraging cloud environments to scale our development, testing, and build systems
• Improving the performance and usability of existing products, features, and automated systems
• Collaborating and mentor engineers on a global distributed team to ensure we are using standard methodologies to build scalable, secure, and operationally sound tools and systems.
• Documenting and evangelizing products, features for use by engineers for the development, testing, and packaging of their products
• Implementing and maintaining Kubernetes operators
• Must be able to independently take a feature from design to implementation, delivering according to release dates and deadlines. Working across different development teams in order to ensure cross dependency.
• Developing distributed systems for Kubernetes environments
• Technical writing for customer-facing product documentation that is passed to the documentation team, and documentation for internal stakeholders.
• Ability to present technical explanations to engineering audiences and internal stakeholders in English.
## What you will bring:
• Hands-on experience authoring Kubernetes Operators.
• Expert in Golang (Go).
• Deep Kubernetes experience, both managed (e.g. Cloud) and self-managed (e.g. OpenShift, Rancher)
• Container build tooling: Docker, multi-stage and CI image builds.
• Traditional enterprise networking patterns and best practices.
• Ability to manage work in a globally distributed remote environment.
## What will set you apart:
• Familiar with OpenShift, familiar for design systems for OpenShift / RHOS packaging and Red Hat certification.
• Appliance or cloud-marketplace delivery, including air-gapped and private-registry install scenarios.
• IAM, Object Storage, Cloud Storage
• Observability for Postgres workloads.
• CI/CD with GitHub Actions; infrastructure-as-code and config management; linting (hadolint, pre-commit).
• Using CloudNativePG or comparable Postgres operators, with solid Postgres operational knowledge.
• High-availability and distributed systems.

Excellent communication skills to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A commitment to staying updated with the latest cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and infrastructure trends to effectively adapt and implement new solutions.

description:
## What You'll Do
Avalara is accelerating an AI-first transformation in which agentic systems will change how customers, partners, and employees complete tax compliance work. This role exists now to help build and scale the Avalara Avi Agent (AAA), the agentic engineering foundation required for Aviator and future agentic capabilities across Avalara. The person in this role will turn emerging AI patterns into secure, reliable, production-grade systems that increase automation, improve customer outcomes, and enable Avalara teams to build agentic solutions faster and with higher quality.
## How This Role Elevates Avalara
As an Agentic and Machine Learning Engineer V, you will raise Avalara's ability to deliver AI-powered products at enterprise scale. Your work will help establish reusable platform capabilities, implementation patterns, evaluation practices, and operational standards for agentic applications. By improving the reliability, accuracy, security, and scalability of these systems, you will enable faster delivery of Aviator and other agentic efforts while reducing duplicated engineering effort across teams. The impact of this role will be visible in stronger customer experiences, more efficient compliance workflows, and a higher bar for AI engineering across Avalara.
## What Your Responsibilities Will Be
• Design, build, and operate foundational agentic platform capabilities that enable Aviator, AAA, and other Avalara agentic experiences to move from prototype to production.
• Develop scalable LLM application frameworks, orchestration patterns, tool integrations, and agent workflows that support enterprise-grade reliability, observability, security, and maintainability.
• Create and improve evaluation methods for agentic outcomes, including quality, accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task-completion effectiveness.
• Translate ambiguous business and product needs into technical designs, prototypes, production features, and measurable engineering outcomes.
• Apply modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, code review, documentation, and operational readiness, to ensure high-quality delivery.
• Partner with product, engineering, security, data, and business stakeholders to ensure agentic capabilities solve meaningful customer and operational problems.
• Research, assess, and responsibly apply emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, model-context protocols, agent-to-agent patterns, retrieval, evaluation, and automation techniques.
• Document reusable patterns and implementation guidance that help Avalara engineers and software agents build consistently, safely, and efficiently.
• Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, coaching, and examples of high-ownership execution.
• Strengthen the operational robustness of mature high-availability systems while introducing new AI capabilities without compromising customer trust or production stability.
## 12-Month Success Signals
• Aviator and other priority agentic initiatives are using production-grade platform capabilities owned or significantly shaped by this role.
• Reusable frameworks, libraries, or service patterns reduce the time required for Avalara teams to build and launch agentic workflows.
• Agentic systems have measurable evaluation coverage for quality, accuracy, reliability, cost, latency, and safety, with improvement trends visible over time.
• Critical agentic services meet agreed operational readiness standards, including observability, incident response, testing, documentation, and scalability targets.
• Stakeholders can point to measurable business or customer impact, such as increased automation, faster workflow completion, improved experience quality, or reduced manual effort.
• The engineer has raised team capability through mentoring, clear technical direction, stronger code/design review practices, and documented patterns that others reuse.
## AI Expectations
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role must demonstrate applied AI capability, not casual tool usage. The person in this role is expected to embed AI into how engineering work gets done and to help others do the same responsibly.
• Use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering speed, design exploration, testing, code quality, documentation, debugging, operational analysis, and knowledge reuse.
• Identify AI opportunities tied to measurable outcomes such as customer experience, workflow automation, developer productivity, reliability, cost efficiency, and risk reduction.
• Apply AI responsibly, securely, and ethically, including attention to data handling, governance, evaluation, auditability, and failure modes.
• Bring evidence to AI decisions, including impact metrics, tradeoff analysis, and clear reasoning for tool, model, protocol, or architecture choices.
• Share AI practices, prompts, evaluation methods, implementation patterns, and lessons learned to raise the AI capability of peers and partner teams.
## Bar Raiser Expectations
This role is expected to raise the average performance of the team by improving technical judgment, execution quality, accountability, and business impact. The successful candidate will hold themselves and others to high standards, simplify complexity, challenge assumptions respectfully, use data in decision-making, and leave systems, processes, and teams stronger than they found them.
## What You'll Need to be Successful
• B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
• 8+ years of relevant professional experience building, deploying, and operating production software systems, with strong preference for Python experience.
• Hands-on experience building LLM applications, agentic systems, or AI-enabled workflows in production or production-like environments.
• Experience with LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Llama, or similar models, including practical understanding of prompting, orchestration, evaluation, and reliability considerations.
• Experience with enterprise-scale software design, distributed systems, data structures, design patterns, and high-availability system operations.
• Experience working in cloud computing environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Applied familiarity with modern agentic integration patterns and protocols, such as MCP, A2A, tool use, retrieval, and multi-agent orchestration.
• Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve measurable outcomes, such as speed, quality, automation, insight, customer experience, or scale.
• Strong communication, documentation, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Avalara is an AI-first Company
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.
## How We'll Take Care of You
Total Rewards
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
## What You Need To Know About Avalara
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

Achieving that vision requires both direct support to families and changes in the housing systems that shape whether low-income households can access affordable, appropriate, and resilient housing. TCIS identifies constraints within housing systems and works with partners to test, refine, and scale solutions across areas including housing finance, construction products and services, and enabling policy environments. As Habitat advances its 50 for 50 strategy, TCIS is also strengthening how its expertise, evidence, tools, and approaches can be accessed and applied across teams, geographies, and the wider Habitat network.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members.

You’ll develop and improve machine learning models that identify harmful listings and suspicious behaviour across the marketplace, while minimising friction on legitimate members. Working with text, images and behavioural data, you’ll apply practical machine learning techniques to evolving detection challenges.

You’ll work closely with Data Scientists, Decision Scientists, Product Managers and engineers to turn ideas into reliable production solutions. You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects across the ML lifecycle, from understanding the data and developing models to deployment, evaluation and ongoing maintenance.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Develop, evaluate and improve machine learning models that detect harmful content and behaviour at scale.
  • Engineer features, prepare training and evaluation datasets, understanding their limitations and addressing issues such as noisy labels, class imbalance and data leakage.
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate models into production and develop reliable training and inference pipelines using established tooling.
  • Work with Decision Scientists and Product Managers to define success metrics and evaluate model improvements through offline analysis and online experimentation, balancing detection coverage with false positives and member experience.
  • Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in their effectiveness and improve them as harmful behaviour and underlying data evolve.
  • Write reliable, maintainable and reproducible code, document your work, share learnings and contribute ideas to the team’s roadmap.

About you 

  • Practical experience developing machine learning solutions, with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistics and probability theory.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn or PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience preparing training datasets, engineering features, training models and evaluating them against baselines and metrics.
  • Experience applying machine learning to at least one of the following: tabular or behavioural data, natural language processing, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with the production ML lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring and retraining.
  • Ability to break down problems into manageable steps, work independently within an agreed scope and seek input when needed.
  • Ability to communicate your approach, findings and trade-offs clearly, collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues, and learn from feedback.
  • Motivation to apply machine learning to member safety, with care for data privacy and the consequences of incorrect predictions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud detection, content classification or other Trust & Safety applications.
  • Experience with transformers, multimodal models or LLM-based workflows.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
About Vitestro
Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.
By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.
At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.
We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."
You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.
If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.
First months at Vitestro
In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.
This is what success looks like:
After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.
Key Responsibilities:
Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory
Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit
Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.
Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time
Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice
Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution
Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces
What You’ll Bring:
Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows
Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production
Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for
A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production
Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration
Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications
Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure
Professional English; Dutch is a plus
Nice to have:
Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up
Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry
Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)
Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
How We Work
At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.
We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:
We take initiative rather than wait for direction.
We focus on execution and delivering results.
We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.
We challenge ideas, not people.
We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.
We celebrate team success over individual heroics.
We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.
If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

Competitive salary including a pension plan

Impact on Infrastructure: This isn't a "code monkey" role. You will have a direct say in how we clean up our MVVM structure and set the engineering standards for the next few years.
## Position – how you’ll contribute
• Standardizing and refining our existing MVVM architecture to improve predictability and scalability.
• Leading the implementation of the first Jetpack Compose modules, setting the blueprint for a full UI migration.
• Developing new features for our logistics engine, including real-time tracking, offline data synchronization, and hardware integration.
• Identifying and systematically addressing technical debt to transform "chaotic" modules into clean, maintainable code.
• Collaborating with the 4 other Android peers to establish best practices and unified coding standards.
• Ensuring high-quality output through meaningful Code Reviews and a proactive approach to automated testing.
## Expectations – the experience you need
• At least 3–5 years of commercial experience in Android development.
• Expert-level knowledge of Kotlin (we value idiomatic, clean code).
• Solid understanding of MVVM and the ability to distinguish between "good" and "chaotic" implementations.
• Hands-on experience with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for asynchronous programming.
• Proficiency with Android Jetpack libraries (Navigation, Room, ViewModel, etc.).
• A "refactoring mindset" – you enjoy bringing order to complex systems and see technical debt as an opportunity to build better.
## Additional skills – the edge you have
• Early-adopter experience with Jetpack Compose (commercial or significant side projects).
• Previous experience in Logistics, GIS, or Fleet Management apps.
• Knowledge of modularization strategies in large Android projects.
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and static analysis tools (e.g., Detekt, SonarQube).
## What we offer:

• International projects with leading global clients
• Travels related to international projects

• Access* to knowledge-sharing initiatives
• Access* to private healthcare and life insurance

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst / Data Engineer
description:
## Why Join GEICO?
At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.
Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.
Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.
## Overview:
The Business Intelligence Analyst III / IV is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence and visual analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. This role transforms complex data into meaningful reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that support operational and strategic business outcomes.
The associate partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and data engineering partners to deliver scalable visual reporting solutions, establish semantic modeling standards, and translate advanced analyses into clear recommendations. Microsoft Power BI is the primary business intelligence platform for this role; however, the associate is expected to remain agile and use Apache Superset or other visualization tools when they are better suited to the business need.
As a member of an agile team, the incumbent contributes to solution design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, production support, report certification, and modernization of enterprise reporting assets. The role focuses on business intelligence and visual analytics rather than primary ownership of source-data engineering or Power BI tenant administration.
Level Expectations :
Business Intelligence Analyst III: Designs end-to-end BI solutions, including semantic and metric layers, data models, reports, and dashboards. Applies advanced analytical and statistical techniques to move reporting from descriptive insight toward diagnostic analysis of performance drivers and customer behavior, while introducing predictive approaches where appropriate. Works independently with minimal guidance, leads solution components, partners with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, and provides technical guidance to peers.
Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Leads the design of complex, reusable BI solutions and serves as a technical lead for reporting and analytics initiatives. Balances regular delivery responsibilities with leadership of cross-functional projects, establishes semantic modeling and reporting standards, reviews technical designs, influences BI architecture and tooling decisions, and mentors analysts and developers across levels.
## Responsibilities:
• Design end-to-end business intelligence solutions, including semantic and metric layers, dimensional data models, reports, dashboards, scorecards, and visual analytics products.
• Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using DAX, Power Query, and enterprise reporting standards.
• Apply advanced analytical and statistical techniques to identify trends, performance drivers, customer behaviors, and opportunities for operational improvement.
• Translate descriptive reporting into diagnostic insight and introduce predictive approaches where appropriate to the business question and available data.
• Partner with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, evaluate findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, compelling recommendations.
• Establish, document, and promote semantic modeling standards, reusable design patterns, visualization standards, and reporting best practices.
• Support report certification by validating solution quality, consistency, usability, maintainability, performance, documentation, and adherence to established standards.
• Publish and support Power BI solutions through Power BI Service, including Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
• Optimize report and semantic model performance, refresh reliability, storage-mode selection, and overall user experience across BI platforms.
• Assess the downstream impact of design choices involving Import, DirectQuery, composite models, Row-Level Security, refresh strategies, and available Power BI capacity.
• Evaluate visualization technologies and select Power BI, Apache Superset, or other appropriate tools based on business need, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
• Use Snowflake and other approved enterprise data sources to deliver reliable, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
• Coordinate with data engineering and technology partners to ensure source data is available, reliable, understandable, and usable for reporting.
• Document report definitions, calculations, assumptions, semantic models, technical designs, and support procedures.
• Lead improvements to reporting processes, including automation of recurring outputs and reduction of manual effort.
• Support report migration and modernization initiatives, including conversion of legacy reporting solutions to modern BI platforms and reusable semantic model architectures.
• Perform testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and post-implementation support.
• Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, status reporting, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
• Provide technical guidance to team members through design, DAX, query, and solution reviews.
• Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Serve as technical lead for complex reporting and analytics initiatives, lead cross-team projects, review technical designs, and mentor analysts and developers across levels.
## Qualifications:
• Advanced experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI or comparable enterprise visualization platforms.
• Strong proficiency with DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, Power Query, data visualization, and enterprise BI architecture.
• Experience publishing and supporting Power BI solutions through Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
• Advanced SQL knowledge, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries used in reporting and analytics solutions.
• Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an agile delivery environment.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable solutions with minimal guidance.
• Must have the following experience:
• Business Intelligence Analyst III: 4-7 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
• Business Intelligence Analyst IV: 7-10 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
• Experience developing enterprise dashboards, reports, semantic models, and visual analytics solutions.
• Experience partnering with stakeholders to define business questions, gather requirements, assess findings, and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
• Experience working with enterprise data platforms and large-scale datasets.
## Preferred Qualifications:
• Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
• Microsoft Power BI administration certification or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of Power BI administration concepts.
• Strongly preferred experience with Microsoft Fabric features such as Lakehouses, Warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, and related capabilities.
• Strongly preferred experience using Snowflake as a primary enterprise data source for reporting and analytics.
• Experience with Apache Superset or other business intelligence and visualization platforms, with the ability to select the appropriate visual tool for the business use case.
• Experience developing or supporting Apache Airflow workflows.
• Experience with Power BI Project (PBIP) formats and collaborative development of Power BI assets.
• Experience using Git-based version control, including branching, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
• Knowledge of Power BI administration and architecture concepts, including capacity management, storage modes, licensing, workspaces, tenant considerations, governance, and performance optimization.
• Understanding of performance and capacity considerations involving DirectQuery, Import mode, composite models, incremental refresh, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to generate or refine scripts, troubleshoot solutions, create documentation, support testing, and accelerate analytics delivery.
• Working knowledge of Python, scripting, or related programming concepts, with emphasis on effectively reviewing, validating, and applying AI-generated code.
• Experience supporting report certification, semantic modeling standards, and reporting modernization initiatives.
• Experience with Azure DevOps or a comparable agile work management and delivery platform.
• Property and Casualty insurance, claims analytics, finance analytics, or enterprise reporting experience.
Annual Salary
$109,675.00 - $172,200.00

Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

Це можливість розвивати свої технічні навички, працювати з Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD та поступово поглиблювати знання в адмініструванні й автоматизації інфраструктури.
## Про нас
Kyivstar.Tech – українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв'язку.
Наша місія – змінювати життя в Україні та в світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.
Понад 700 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та веб-рішення, а також проектування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.
Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен з нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове
## Що ти будеш робити
• Траблшутити та усувати помилки
• Налаштовувати моніторинг за участю та підтримки колег із відділу моніторингу
• Налаштовувати інцидент-менеджмент за участю та підтримки колег із відділу моніторингу
• Розробляти та реалізовувати плани бекапування
• Розробляти та реалізовувати автоматизоване розгортання
• Розробляти IaC-рішення
• Писати технічну документацію
• Опрацьовувати інциденти
• Налагоджувати комунікацію між відділами для побудови автоматизованого моніторингу Core-сервісів компанії
• Проводити рев'ю та аналіз коректності даних реалізованих дашбордів у Grafana
Адмініструвати інфраструктуру VMware (VCF):
• Тестувати нові впровадження від вендорів
• Вдосконалювати існуючі рішення
## Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні
• Linux (Oracle Linux / Red Hat): базові навички адміністрування, робота з командним рядком, службами, процесами, правами доступу та логами.
• Docker: практичний досвід роботи з контейнерами, створення Docker-образів та налаштування їхнього запуску.
• Kubernetes: розуміння основних компонентів, робота з kubectl та базова діагностика проблем.
• CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI): розуміння принципів роботи пайплайнів, навички їх читання, редагування та пошуку помилок.
• Ansible: базовий досвід роботи з playbook, inventory та автоматизацією конфігурацій.
• Git: впевнена робота з гілками, комітами, merge request та вирішенням конфліктів.
• Моніторинг (Grafana, Elastic Stack): базові навички роботи з дашбордами та логами.
• Бази даних (MariaDB, Oracle, PostgreSQL): базові знання SQL та принципів роботи реляційних баз даних.
• Bash: навички написання та редагування простих скриптів.
• Особисті якості: аналітичне мислення, уважність, готовність навчатися, працювати в команді та дотримуватися технічних процедур.
• Англійська: на рівні читання та розуміння технічної документації.
## Плюсом стане
• Linux: досвід системного моніторингу та діагностики продуктивності.
• Docker: робота з Docker Compose та приватними реєстрами образів.
• Kubernetes: досвід розгортання застосунків за допомогою Helm.
• CI/CD: досвід створення пайплайнів із нуля.
• Ansible: робота з ролями та AWX.
• Terraform: розуміння IaC, досвід роботи з конфігураціями та базовими командами.
• Хмарні платформи (Azure, AWS): базове знайомство з основними хмарними сервісами.
• VMware: досвід роботи з VMware vSphere та адміністрування віртуальних машин.
• Бази даних: досвід резервного копіювання, відновлення та базового налаштування.
• Python: базові навички написання скриптів.
• AI-агенти: досвід використання AI-асистентів для автоматизації інфраструктурних завдань, перевірки скриптів і конфігурацій, розуміння ризиків їх використання.
## Що ми пропонуємо
• Офіс чи ремоут — вирішувати тобі
• Ремоут онбординг
• Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)
• Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека
• Страхування здоров’я і життя для працівників
• Wellbeing-програма та корпоративний психолог
• Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв'язок Київстар

title: ServiceNow Experience Designer/Portal Developer
description:
## Overview
Job Title: ServiceNow Experience Designer & Portal DeveloperLocation: Remote - US or Canada
Job Type: Independent Contract Start Date: ASAP
Pay Rate: $70-80/hr
## Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled ServiceNow Experience Designer and Portal Developer to design, develop, and optimize responsive, user-friendly enterprise portals and Employee Center experiences. Design intuitive employee and agent experiences on the ServiceNow platform, with a focus on Employee Center and Service Operations Workspace (SOW). You will work closely with UX designers, business stakeholders, and system architects to translate business requirements into intuitive self-service web interfaces using ServiceNow’s Service Portal framework, AngularJS, JavaScript, and modern web standards.
## Responsibilities
## Key Responsibilities
• Design end-to-end employee and agent journeys: onboarding/offboarding, issue-to-resolution, request-to-fulfillment, and self-service search and knowledge (deflection).
• Create UX artifacts such as personas, journey maps, empathy maps, and wireframes/prototypes.
• Plan and run usability tests, and turn findings into design improvements.
• Design and configure experiences in Employee Center, SOW, and UI Builder.
• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to deliver consistent, accessible, user-centered solutions.
• Employee Center / CSM Configuration: Implement and configure Employee Center Core/Pro features, Unified Navigation, and content-driven portals.
• Service Catalog Integration: Build and modify Service Catalog items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variable Sets, and Catalog Client Scripts.
• Performance & Optimization: Analyze and resolve portal performance bottlenecks using Chrome DevTools, network profiling, and clean widget architecture.
• Security & Governance: Configure Access Control Lists (ACLs), Data Policies, and contextual security for portal components.
• Deployment & Lifecycle: Manage Update Sets, Scoped Applications, source control integration, and platform upgrade support.
## Qualifications
## Required Technical Skills
• 6+ years in ServiceNow Development, including 2+ years on ServiceNow Portal and UI builder development.
• Scripting & APIs: Develop server-side and client-side scripts using GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideForm (g_form), and REST/SOAP APIs.
• ServiceNow Core: Strong command of the ServiceNow platform, Flow Designer, Business Rules, and Script Includes.
• UI Builder & Experience Framework: Building and configuring modern portal pages, record pages, and appshells.
• UIB Components & Layouts: Creating and customising Now Components using @servicenow/ui-core.
• Declarative Actions & Client State Parameters: Wiring UI interactions without custom scripts where possible.
• Data Resources & REST API Bindings: Connecting UI elements to back-end data sources within UIB.
• Contextual Sidepanel & Split-View Layouts: Designing context-aware, multi-panel user experiences.
• Portal & Widget Development: Design, build, and customize responsive Service Portal widgets, pages, themes, and navigation menus using AngularJS 1.x, JavaScript, HTML5, SCSS, and Bootstrap.
• Portal Stack: Deep experience with ServiceNow Service Portal, Page Designer, widget scripting (Client Controller, Server Script, HTML template), and CSS/SCSS.
• Web Technologies: Proficiency in JavaScript (ES5/ES6), AngularJS 1.x, HTML5, Bootstrap, and REST/JSON integrations.
## Certifications:
• Certified System Administrator (CSA) - Required
• Certified Application Developer (CAD) or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS-Service Portal / CIS-CSM) - Required
• Employee Center Essentials badge - Preferred
• Service Operations Workspace (SOW) Bootcamp badge- Preferred
• UI Builder Fundamentals badge/certification- Preferred

title: Machine Learning Engineer III
description:
## What You'll Do
You’ll join the HS Code Classification team, which helps businesses that ship goods across borders get the right tariff code for every product, and cuts down the manual work our classification experts do today. Here you’ll own models from first experiment to production, work on a hard real-world problem with thousands of codes and messy product data, and see the results used directly by customers.
• Build intelligent systems that classify, extract, validate, and reason over complex business data and multiple languages
• Improve automation quality through applied ML, GenAI, retrieval, and evaluation-driven development
• Integrate model improvements into production workflows and user-facing experiences
• Support fast, reliable ML services that can operate in real-time and high-volume environments
• Improve data quality detection so downstream AI systems operate on inputs that are complete and actionable
You’ll work on text classification, data quality checks, model evaluation, small language models, RAG, and faster inference. You’ll also build AI agents that can reason through multi-step tasks, build MCP to connect them to tools and data they need. The role needs hands-on ML skills, strong engineering, and the ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and domain teams.
## This role is remote.
## What Your Responsibilities Will Be
• Build and improve ML systems for product classification, document understanding, data quality checks, and retrieval
• Fine-tune, test, and deploy models, including transformers and small language models
• Build AI agents that reason through multi-step tasks and use MCP to connect to tools and data
• Write backend services, APIs, and pipelines that bring models into production
• Set up evaluations to track accuracy, speed, reliability, and where models fail
• Add GenAI features such as chat, retrieval, and clear explanations of results to the product
• Keep systems production-ready with testing, monitoring, and documentation
• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to turn ambiguous needs into working solutions
• Take part in design reviews, code reviews, and experiments to keep improving our systems
• Main tools: Python, transformer models, LLMs, MCP, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, AWS, GitLab, Postgres, and Prometheus, Hex Dashboards , CI/CD deployments
## What You'll Need to be Successful
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, including building and deploying ML or LLM-based systems in production.
• Strong Python skills, plus experience building backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. Familiarity with other languages is a plus.
• Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, such as prompt engineering, tool and function calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and working with models via APIs or Bedrock.
• Practical experience with agentic development, including multi-step agents, orchestration patterns, and agent frameworks.
• Delivered production-ready ML improvements for one or more AI-powered workflows.
• Improved model quality, latency, reliability, or user experience for a production ML system
• Built or enhanced evaluation pipelines that make model performance easier to measure and improve
• Integrated ML capabilities into backend services, APIs, or user-facing workflows
• Contributed to data quality or input validation capabilities that improve downstream model performance
• Demonstrated strong ownership of well-scoped technical workstreams with guidance from senior engineers
• Improved engineering quality through reliable implementation, testing, documentation, and production support.
Avalara is an AI-first Company
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.
## How We'll Take Care of You
Total Rewards
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
## What You Need To Know About Avalara
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

description:
The Site Reliability Specialist II contributes to the operational stability and performance of Intelerad’s healthcare imaging platforms with growing independence. This role takes ownership of defined monitoring, database maintenance, and cloud operations tasks, responds to incidents with increasing autonomy, and begins to drive improvements in systems and processes. As this individual deepens their expertise across system administration, SQL performance, and cloud infrastructure, they play an active role in helping the team maintain the high availability standards that healthcare providers depend on.
## Key Responsibilities:
• Maintain system reliability across production environments by monitoring infrastructure health, independently investigating and resolving performance issues, and ensuring consistent uptime for Intelerad’s healthcare imaging platforms with escalation to senior specialists for complex scenarios.
• Execute and optimize SQL database maintenance by performing routine and non-routine maintenance tasks, analyzing basic query performance issues, supporting backup and recovery operations, and escalating advanced tuning requirements to senior team members.
• Support cloud infrastructure operations by administering and maintaining cloud-based deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), implementing infrastructure changes using established patterns, and contributing to the migration of on-premises systems to cloud environments.
• Respond to incidents with increasing ownership by independently diagnosing system and database issues of moderate complexity, executing resolution steps, contributing to root cause analysis, and recommending preventive measures to reduce recurrence.
• Advance continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to automate recurring manual tasks, improving monitoring coverage and alerting accuracy, updating runbooks and documentation, and contributing to team projects that enhance platform reliability.
## Qualifications & Experience
• 3+ years of experience in system administration, site reliability engineering, technical operations, or a related role supporting production environments.
• Working knowledge of SQL Server administration, including query execution, index concepts, backup and recovery, and database maintenance tasks.
• Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including compute, storage, and networking fundamentals.
• Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration, including scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).
• Experience using monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, DataDog, or similar) to identify and investigate system issues.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
## Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements
• Cloud certification (AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator, or equivalent).
• Experience with healthcare IT systems, particularly PACS, RIS, or medical imaging platforms.
• Knowledge of healthcare data standards and compliance requirements (HIPAA, DICOM, HL7).
• Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates).
• Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Familiarity with SQL Server high availability concepts (Always On, clustering, replication).
• Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
• Ability to participate in on-call rotation.
• Flexibility to respond to critical incidents outside standard business hours.
## Travel Requirements
Occasional travel may be required for client escalations or team collaboration (up to 10%).
This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.
The base pay for this position ranges from $82,500 - $110,000 USD within any geographic market in the US. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.
Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. title: Web Developer (PHP & JavaScript)
description:
The Eclipse Foundation is a globally recognised not-for-profit organisation that supports a
vibrant community of open source projects and contributors. With a commitment to vendor neutrality and transparency, we provide a collaborative environment for innovation across industries, including cloud, edge, AI, and developer tooling. Our team is remote first, inclusive, and passionate about open source.
Position Summary
The Eclipse Foundation is seeking a skilled Web Developer to join our Software Development team. This is a new role where you will help build, maintain, and modernise the web platforms that support our global open source community and internal operations.
Your primary focus will be developing and maintaining Drupal websites, modernising legacy PHP applications, and building new applications using Symfony. You will also work with JavaScript, APIs, and other web technologies, contributing to front-end development and supporting applications built with frameworks such as React, Nuxt.js, and Hugo when needed.
We are looking for someone with strong PHP, Symfony, Drupal, and JavaScript skills who can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and work across different applications and frameworks.
Reporting to the Web Development Team Lead, you will take ownership of your work, contribute to technical decisions, and collaborate with colleagues to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, accessible, and maintainable solutions.
This is an opportunity to work with a range of technologies, engage directly with open source communities, and deliver solutions that have a global impact.
Salary Range: $75,000–$95,000 in Canada and €45,000–€60,000 in Europe.
Location: This is a remote position. The selected candidate will work from their home office.All qualified candidates will be considered, with preference for candidates based in
Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and Belgium.
Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain Drupal websites, including custom modules, themes, and integrations.
• Build new web applications and internal tools using Symfony and modern PHP
• development practices.

• Develop and maintain front-end functionality using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Twig.
• Support applications using other web technologies and frameworks, including Bootstrap,

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience developing and maintaining applications using Symfony and Drupal 11.
• Experience building and maintaining custom Drupal modules, themes, and integrations.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
## About us:
At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.
## Position Overview:
The Salesforce Developer owns Fullbay’s Salesforce platform end to end, from day-to-day administration and configuration through custom Apex and Lightning Web Component development. This role determines when a requirement calls for declarative configuration and when it calls for code, then builds the solution directly. Working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations stakeholders across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and the Nue CPQ platform and its integrations with QuickBooks and Stripe, the Salesforce Developer is accountable for both the daily health of the platform and its long-term technical architecture.
## Right Wrench for the Job:
The right wrench for this job enjoys the full spectrum of Salesforce work, from resolving a user’s support request in the morning to delivering a custom Apex integration in the afternoon. This individual takes ownership of both the daily health of the platform and its long-term architecture, builds solutions that scale, and partners with Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand the business need before building.
## Primary Duties & Responsibilities:
• Platform Ownership & Administration
• Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and health of the Salesforce platform across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and Nue CPQ
• Debug and resolve production issues in a timely manner across both configuration and code
• Manage sandbox environments and CI/CD / change-set deployment processes
• Development & Engineering
• Design and develop custom Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, and scheduled jobs
• Build and maintain Lightning Web Components (LWC) for custom UI experiences
• Develop and maintain REST/SOAP API integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems (QuickBooks, Stripe, Nue CPQ)
• Write clean, well-documented, testable code with a minimum of 85% code coverage
• Determine whether a given requirement is best solved with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) or custom code, and build accordingly
• Project Delivery & Architecture
• Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions
• Build and deploy Flows, validation rules, custom objects, fields, and page layouts
• Ensure solutions are scalable, governor-limit compliant, and built for long-term maintainability
• Document configurations, technical designs, data models, and integration specifications for ongoing maintainability
• Participate in sprint planning and project intake prioritization with RevOps leadership
• Consulting & Strategy
• Proactively identify and recommend improvements to existing processes and data models
• Partner with Revenue Operations to align Salesforce capabilities to business goals
• Stay current on Salesforce releases, Einstein AI features, developer tools, and platform updates; evaluate and implement relevant new functionality
• General
• Adheres to all confidentiality, compliance, and company standards
• Performs other duties as assigned
## Minimum Education & Work Experience:
• 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration / development experience, including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce data model design
• 1 year of AI experience and switching processes over to using AI
• Strong proficiency with Salesforce Flow (Screen Flows, Record-Triggered Flows, and Scheduled Flows)
• Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC) and an understanding of the Lightning component framework
• Experience with Sales Cloud, including opportunity management, lead routing, and forecasting
• Experience building and maintaining REST or SOAP API integrations
• Deep understanding of Salesforce governor limits, bulkification, and asynchronous processing patterns
• Demonstrated ability to manage projects end to end, from requirements through deployment
• At least 2 active Salesforce certifications spanning both the administrator and developer tracks, with preference for:
• Salesforce Certified Administrator
• Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
• Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator
• Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
• Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
• Salesforce Certified Integration Architecture Designer
• Agentforce Specialist
• Preferred qualifications
• Experience with CPQ tools (Nue, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) and order-to-cash / quote-to-cash workflows
• Familiarity with QuickBooks and/or Stripe integrations and APIs
• Experience with Einstein AI features, including Einstein Copilot, Lead Scoring, or Opportunity Insights
• Knowledge of Agentforce or generative AI tooling within the Salesforce ecosystem
• Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX), scratch orgs, and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset)
• Exposure to platform events, Change Data Capture (CDC), or the Salesforce streaming API
• Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business model
## Key Skills and Qualifications:
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
• Sound judgment in choosing between declarative configuration and custom code, and the ability to build either
• Strong requirements-gathering and project management skills, from intake through deployment
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing production issues across configuration and code
• Commitment to clean, documented, testable, and maintainable work
• Consultative mindset, with the initiative to recommend improvements to existing processes and data models
## Physical Demands and Work Environment:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
• Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
• Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
• Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
• Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
• Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.
Salary: $151,465.68 - $185,545.46

• Build solutions leveraging RAG, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, agent-based workflows, and AI orchestration frameworks.
• Develop reusable AI services, evaluation frameworks, telemetry solutions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
• Support responsible AI implementation, governance, monitoring, and compliance requirements.
## We'd Love to Hear From You If...
## Experience
• You have a minimum of 8 years of software engineering experience.
• You have a strong track record delivering enterprise-scale full stack applications.
• You have experience working across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and DevOps domains.
• You have experience building and supporting customer-facing and enterprise digital platforms.

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
• You have strong expertise in React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

• You have expertise in Azure or AWS cloud platforms, containerisation, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
• You have experience with automated testing frameworks, source control systems, deployment pipelines, and site reliability engineering practices.

• You balance innovation, security, scalability, and operational excellence.
• You demonstrate strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and ownership of delivery outcomes.

title: AI Tutor, Medicine - Temporary
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
## AI TUTOR, MEDICINE - TEMPORARY
In this role, you will help enhance Grok by creating and annotating high-quality data across the field of medicine. You will draw on your clinical expertise to evaluate model outputs, identify errors in clinical reasoning, and capture how clinicians think, communicate with patients, and navigate complex medical decisions. Your work will help train Grok to distinguish unsafe or clinically flawed responses from guidance that is evidence-based, diagnostically precise, and consistent with the standard of care. This work spans text, voice, and video, including recording audio and participating in video sessions.
## RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Use proprietary software to create, label, and annotate data on defined medical projects.
• Produce high-quality data efficiently, with exceptional attention to accuracy.
• Help design and launch new medical data tasks, working closely with colleagues and technical staff to bring cutting-edge initiatives to life.
• Partner with engineers to improve the design of fast, efficient annotation tools.
• Help put trustworthy medical information within reach of patients and users worldwide.
• Improve patient outcomes by solving real healthcare problems that train Grok to meet clinical standards across decision-making, drug discovery, diagnostic imaging, and procedures.
• Create and solve complex medical problems within your area of expertise, such as diagnostic reasoning, treatment planning, care coordination, or image interpretation, writing detailed reference answers and critically evaluating model responses.
• Interpret, analyze, and carry out tasks based on evolving instructions.
## POSITION DETAILS:
This is a temporary position with SpaceXSI, for the length of time as stated, and is subject to change with minimal notice as business needs dictate.
• LENGTH OF POSITION: 6 months (extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs).
• LOCATION: Remote (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, India, and Australia); for US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
## BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
• MD, DO, MBBS, MBChB, DNP, PharmD, PsyD, DDS, DMD, DPT, DPM, OTD, or DVM degree, or an international equivalent of one of those degrees; OR a master’s degree or Ph.D. in nursing, physician assistant studies, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, public health, epidemiology, biostatistics, pharmacology, or biomedical sciences.
• 2+ years of employment experience in a clinical, research, or health-related role after the qualifying degree was conferred (completion of a residency or other postgraduate training is not required; residency, fellowship, and internship positions count toward the experience requirement).
• English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.
## PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
• Skill at navigating medical literature, databases, and online resources.
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills.
• Sound independent judgment when information is limited, and the ability to explain your reasoning clearly to others.
• A genuine passion for innovation and for using technology to improve patient care.
• Multiple publications, or a first-author publication, in a reputable journal or outlet.
• Prior data annotation or teaching experience (as a professor, teacher, or tutor).
• Experience in technical writing, medical writing, journalism, or another professional writing setting.
• Post-graduate clinical experience or equivalent real world experience.
## ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
• This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position depending on role/business needs and candidate availability; full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.
• We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
• Must be willing to travel to a SpaceXSI site.

US-based candidates: $45/hour - $100/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.
Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.
